Get Multiple WMS Basemap Tiles for Large Areas

Source: R/vantor_api_getmap.R
get_maxar_wms_tiles.Rd

Splits a large area of interest into a regular grid of tiles, downloads each tile via get_maxar_wms_basemap(), and optionally merges them into a single GeoTIFF, terra::SpatRaster, or stars object.

Usage

get_maxar_wms_tiles(
  bbox,
  token = NULL,
  api_key = NULL,
  tile_size = 2500,
  output_dir = tempfile(pattern = "vantor_tiles_"),
  merge_tiles = TRUE,
  final_output = tempfile(pattern = "vantor_merged_", fileext = ".tif"),
  return_type = c("file", "SpatRaster", "stars", "stars_proxy"),
  progress_callback = NULL,
  verbose = getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE),
  ...
)

Arguments

bbox

A spatial object (sf, sfc, bbox, SpatRaster, SpatVector, SpatExtent, stars, stars_proxy) or a numeric vector of length 4.

token

Character string. Optional OAuth2 bearer token.

api_key

Character string. Optional Maxar/Vantor API key.

tile_size

Numeric. Size of each tile side in meters. Default is 2500 (2.5 km).

output_dir

Character string. Directory for individual tile files. Defaults to a new directory inside tempdir() in compliance with CRAN policy.

merge_tiles

Logical. Merge downloaded tiles into a single mosaic. Default is TRUE (requires the terra package).

final_output

Character string. File path for the merged GeoTIFF. Defaults to tempfile(pattern = "vantor_merged_", fileext = ".tif").

return_type

Character string. One of "file", "SpatRaster", "stars", or "stars_proxy".

progress_callback

Optional function taking (i, n_tiles) called after each tile download (useful for integrating with shiny::incProgress()).

verbose

Logical. Print progress messages. Default is getOption("vantorr.verbose", TRUE).

...

Additional arguments passed to get_maxar_wms_basemap().

Value

If merge_tiles = TRUE, returns the merged output formatted according to return_type. If merge_tiles = FALSE, returns a character vector of downloaded tile file paths.

Examples

# \donttest{
if (vantor_has_auth()) {
  large_aoi <- sf::st_bbox(
    c(xmin = -105.02, ymin = 39.72, xmax = -104.98, ymax = 39.75),
    crs = sf::st_crs(4326)
  )
  merged_path <- get_maxar_wms_tiles(
    bbox = large_aoi,
    tile_size = 2000,
    resolution = 1.0,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}
# }
